finding.mechanism: retrieval_entrypoint_policy mutations and retrieval_feedback idempotency receipt are committed as separate SQLite autocommit statements
finding.failure_mode: a crash after one or more entry-point upserts but before feedback receipt insertion can persist partial learning without the replay receipt; retry can apply the same canonical outcome again
finding.violated_contract: duplicate feedback must be idempotent and restart-safe; adaptive retrieval capital must not be partially or multiply applied

required_repair.rollback_law: any exception before commit leaves both policy state and feedback receipt unchanged

regression_obligation.inject: exception immediately before feedback insertion after at least one policy upsert
require: stale-generation, replay-route and causal-outcome fences remain fail-closed before mutation

go_unusual_experiment.reason: only minute-precision immutable user-message metadata is exposed and no shared immutable request/turn identifier is available; current GO atomic-lease protocol therefore forbids an unusual experiment

evidence_scope: source review and durable coordination only; no exact branch pytest, OCI build/start, Clerk/browser/PTy, or whole ClayVerse runtime PASS
